en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone town square with a central statue of a man in a long coat standing on a pedestal inscribed 'ALBERT.' The statue is surrounded by short posts linked with chains. Behind it are 3–4 storey gabled houses with many windows and flower boxes. Shop signs on the ground floors read in German, including a shoe store and other merchants with striped awnings.
